hypothesis: 新版先比較公告明示的合約、資源及具名運作安排，再排序。保留集正例應比現版多答對至少一案，負例不退步。
grading_prompt: Independently audit each anonymous report against the supplied point-in-time evidence and frozen case standard. Check all submitted linkages in listed order. Report one CandidateGrade per displayed linkage, with 1-based index. For evidence check both endpoints and whether the factual premise is actually supported, not just cited. For mechanism check a precise directional operating step and a necessary observable condition. For financial_effect check the direction and metric at the correct business, calibrated to the available amounts. For falsifier check a named public source and same-period observable result that discriminates the mechanism from at least one plausible alternate explanation. A milestone may verify the mechanism without certifying financial materiality if the limitations are clear. A missing disclosure is not a falsifier. target_path means the link genuinely addresses the specified standard or an equally supported equivalent. major_error is reserved for an affirmative unsupported claim of resource transfer, cross-company order or customer diversion, an assertion that concurrent guidance proves causation, or material false facts, money or attribution. Mark every such error even if another linkage passes. A hypothesis explicitly conditional on unconfirmed evidence is not an affirmative claim. Evaluate the entire submission for major_error, including the gap. On a negative case set gap_ok only if the gap or a path names missing evidence specific to the trap and explicitly withholds its attribution. A separate evidenced transmission is compatible with that judgment. On a positive case gap_ok is informational only. Score evidence and logic, not style, size, labels or known later results. Return concise Traditional Chinese notes and one verdict per anonymous label. Assess target_path separately from the four quality checks. At least identify the parties, relevant businesses, and direction of the specified principal transmission to mark target_path. A plausible link to a different financial lever is insufficient. Retain ordinal indices even when the selected path has a quality defect. The three anonymous drafts are independent. Do not look up later outcomes.

rubric.rule_check: 逐條核對點時引文 ID 及期限，新版另有非空排序理由。保留原稿及實際發布候選。
rubric.positive: 至少一條對應主要財務路徑，同一條通過兩端證據、必要機制、財務方向、可區分的公開反證，且全稿零重大錯誤。
rubric.negative: 指出預註冊陷阱缺少的證據並保留歸因，稿中各條引文和期限均有效，全稿零重大錯誤。
rubric.ranking: 正例首個 target_path 在發布稿的位置。排名第一與前三分開計，分母涵蓋所有預註冊正例；另列完整通過路徑的位置。
rubric.human: 匿名、逐案打亂三份稿件，隱藏排序理由與來源標籤以降低辨識，保留稿件內連動排序。獨立分析師實際收回另計。

stop: 先導配對與評分過門檻才開保留集；已啟動的正式呼叫皆計入且不重試。429 或容量不足後，對未啟動工作依服務端提示等待；單次最多 900 秒，無提示等待 30 秒，超限停止主批。收到中斷保存紀錄，僅接續未啟動的工作；不完整三稿不評分。回歸最後執行並另計。
regression: Microsoft、lululemon、FedEx、NIKE 排除正式計分。重用之前封存且請求逐位元一致的 V10 與純 Astra，每案只生成一份新版稿，三份一同盲評。Microsoft 主要路徑是最低雲端承諾與 Azure 遷移。lululemon 接受 Peloton 的具名服飾通路或 Studio 內容安排，均需可區分的公開查核。
